jobs.description:
Our client, an international company operating in the manufacturing sector, is looking for a Customer Service Representative to join its customer-facing team.

Jobomschrijving

In this role, you will be responsible for managing customer orders from A to Z, ensuring an excellent customer experience, and acting as the key point of contact between customers and internal departments. You will work closely with Sales, Supply Chain, Logistics, and Production teams to guarantee smooth order processing and timely deliveries.Key Responsibilities

• Manage customer orders throughout the entire order-to-cash process.
• Enter and follow up on orders in the ERP system.
• Serve as the primary contact for customer enquiries regarding orders, deliveries, and product availability.
• Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure efficient order fulfillment.
• Monitor delivery schedules and proactively communicate any changes or delays.
• Resolve customer issues and identify appropriate solutions.
• Maintain accurate customer records and administrative documentation.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives related to customer service processes.
• Build and maintain strong long-term customer relationships.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience.
• Previous experience in Customer Service, Order Management, Sales Support, or a similar administrative position.
• Strong communication skills and customer-oriented mindset.
• Fluent in Dutch and English. French is considered an asset.
• Experience working with ERP systems (SAP knowledge is a plus).
• Good command of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.

Personal Skills

• Proactive and solution-oriented.
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
• Able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Team player with a collaborative mindset.
• Resilient and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
• Customer-focused with excellent relationship-building skills.

As a Talent & Business Consultant, you will play a key role in connecting top technology professionals with leading businesses across Belgium.

Operating at the intersection of people and business, you will act as a trusted advisor to both clients and candidates while building your own network and market expertise.

 

Client Details

Our client is a leading international consultancy specialized in Technology and Digital Transformation recruitment. They partner with innovative startups, scale-ups, and global organizations to help them attract the talent shaping tomorrow's digital world.

Driven by entrepreneurship, excellence, and collaboration, they empower their consultants to build strong market expertise, develop meaningful business relationships, and make a lasting impact on companies and professionals alike.

 

Description

Develop your client portfolio

• Build and maintain relationships with technology leaders and hiring managers.
• Identify new business opportunities and expand existing partnerships.
• Understand clients' growth plans, challenges, and recruitment needs.
• Advise clients on talent market trends and hiring strategies.

Connect with top talent

• Identify, attract, and engage highly skilled professionals.
• Conduct in-depth interviews to understand candidates' ambitions and motivations.
• Guide candidates throughout the recruitment process.
• Support professionals in making important career decisions.

Drive successful recruitment projects

• Manage recruitment assignments from A to Z.
• Match talent with business needs.
• Negotiate offers and facilitate successful placements.
• Build long-term relationships with both clients and candidates.

 

You don't necessarily need recruitment experience to succeed.

We are looking for individuals who:

• Speak English with at least a native level in French OR Dutch.
• Are passionate about building relationships.
• Have a strong commercial mindset.
• Enjoy working towards ambitious goals.
• Are naturally curious and eager to learn about businesses and industries.
• Thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.
• Possess excellent communication and influencing skills.
• Are resilient, proactive, and results-oriented.
Experience in sales, consulting, business development, customer success, hospitality, banking, or recruitment is considered a plus.

• Experience with diagnostic tools.

• Team player but can also work independently

As an Air Import Agent, you are responsible for smoothly and timely coordinating air freight and providing excellent customer service. You ensure that everything, from freight transportation to administrative processing, runs seamlessly.

As an Air Import Agent, you engage in the following activities:

• Ensure smooth and timely freight process flow.

• Ensure accurate and timely data entry into our operating system.

• Track and trace Air Import files as required. This can be either internally via exp.o or externally via airline websites or by telephone to
airline offices.

• Use Tree View on daily basis.

• Ensure timely delivery of freight to customers for Import shipments.

• Ensure documents are timely sent to customer or broker for customs purposes.

• Ensure accurate and timely client and vendors billing.

• Interact with our customers in arranging their international shipments, meeting customer service standards.

• Contribute to maintain strong relationships with vendors (airlines, trucking companies, and others).

• Meet compliance at all times to regulations. 

• Understand department process flow, constantly looking for areas of improved efficiency.

• Ensure all customers standard operating procedures are followed and updated in the DLSOP.

• Overseas communications, timely responses to emails and requests (internal and external)

• Meets company standards of 52 hours training per year per employee.

• Promote compliance in diligently following all company policies and regulations and performing the task at hand with outstanding
integrity and pride.

The Air Import Agent we're looking for:

• 2- 3 years of experience withing air freight (import specifically)

• Proactive attitude and well-developed organizational skills.

• Good knowledge of Excel and Word; experience in air freight/logistics is a plus.

• Very good knowledge of English AND Dutch

• IATA certification is a plus.

• A positive mindset, problem-solving ability, and a good sense of humor.

Team/division description:
 

Lexus, One Omnichannel Experience (Lexus, OCX) is the Function that is the promoting the LEXUS brand 360 degree and delivers one seamless omnichannel experience across physical and digital touchpoints. The Function brings under one roof Divisions such as Lexus Brand, Digital Experience & E-Commerce, Data Platforms & Customer Engagement Management (CEM), Customer Relations, Strategy & Performance, and One Academy. Its mission is to define and connect every customer touchpoint across the ONE TOYOTA Ecosystem in an omnichannel way to drive conversion, loyalty and monetisation. AI based automation and self-services are unlocking cost efficiencies, while a system of actionable insights is leading to continuous performance improvements. A unified, centrally governed and legally compliant data foundation is the key enabler for building long term trusted relationships with our customers.
 

Due to its multiple impact across the business, the function should collaborate seamlessly with other TME functions and NMSCs as the primary implementer.
 

Your task: 
 

 
• Agenda, Mailbox, Expense & Travel Management: Manage the Function Head’s agenda, mailbox, travel booking, and expenses.
 
• Team Travel & Expenses: Support team Heads with travel and expenses upon request.
 
• Travel Coordination: Share travel-related information across the function.
 
• All Team meeting organization: Organize Quarterly All Team meeting – book venue, collect and consolidate presentations from each team, present team related content.
 
• Weekly Direct reports meeting / Bi-Weekly Lexus Team Meeting: set-up meeting (including meeting room), consolidate PowerPoint presentation for the meetings, create midterm agenda visibility.
 
• Off-site Meetings: Coordinate logistics, including hotels, catering, venues, and registration.
 
• Events: Organise Christmas parties and team-building activities.
 
• Mailing Lists & Org Charts: Keep mailing groups and organisation charts up to date.
 
• Office Management: Coordinate daily office operations, meeting rooms, and group calendars.
 
• (Oracle Finance system) PR/PO & Supplier Creation: Create PR/Pos when needed (such as special office supply ordering, Teambuilding down payment)
 
• Facilities: Coordinate facility matters, locker lists, and Kara-Kara clean-up activities.
 
• Ad-hoc Support: Support team members with ad-hoc requests.
 
• One Team Sprit: Support the leadership team in building a One Team Sprit considering the diversity of the divisions. 

Your profile:
 

 
• Reliable, Accurate & Proactive: Attention to detail, highly precise, strong organisational skills.
 
• Persistent, Stress-resistant & Hard-working: Focused and resilient in a demanding environment.
 
• Team Player and Independent Worker: Collaborates well and manages tasks independently.
 
• Multicultural Communication: Communicates effectively in diverse environments.
 
• Results-driven: Turns objectives into clear, tangible actions.
 
• Communication and Presentation Skills: Communicates clearly and professionally.
 
• Planning and Organisation: Manages priorities and multiple tasks efficiently.
 
• Discreet: Handles confidential information professionally and with high integrity.
 
• Microsoft Office Skills: Good knowledge of Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Teams.
 
• Fluent in English: Other languages are an asset.

Ready to kick-start your logistics career? On behalf of our client Katoen Natie, we're seeking motivated Order Pickers / Warehouse Employees for their dynamic operations in Gent Zeehaven. This is a temporary contract with excellent potential for permanent employment - your chance to prove yourself while learning from industry experts.

As an order picker, you'll be a crucial link in the international logistics chain, handling valuable materials and ensuring smooth operations for clients worldwide. This versatile role offers the perfect opportunity to develop your skills in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.

• 

• YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Order Picking: Accurately collect goods from warehouse locations using picking lists and handheld scanners

Quality Control: Inspect items for damage and ensure correct quantities before processing

Packing & Preparation: Prepare orders for shipping, including proper packaging and labeling

Receiving: Unload deliveries, check incoming goods, and update inventory systems

Inventory Management: Organize stock locations and maintain warehouse cleanliness

Safety Compliance: Follow all safety protocols and maintain a secure working environment

Team Collaboration: Work effectively with colleagues across different shifts

Continuous Improvement: Suggest ways to optimize processes and increase efficiency

• Essential Requirements:
Basic logistics experience (warehouse, order picking, packing, production) OR strong willingness to learn

Enthusiastic attitude combined with a hands-on mentality - ready to roll up your sleeves!

Reliability and punctuality - your team depends on you

Eye for detail and quality - accuracy is crucial in our operations

Physical fitness - comfortable standing, walking, and lifting throughout your shift

Availability for 2-shift system (early and late shifts)

Basic Dutch or English communication skills

What Makes You Stand Out:

Experience with warehouse management systems (WMS) or scanning equipment

Forklift or reach truck certification (or willingness to obtain)

Previous experience in international logistics or port operations

Multilingual skills for our diverse, international workplace

Positive team player attitude with problem-solving mindset

For the maintenance department of our client located in Grimbergen, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician to work rotating shifts (6:00-14:00 and 14:00-22:00).

This role requires strong technical knowledge, hands-on problem-solving skills, and a commitment to safety. You will troubleshoot mechanical and electrical issues, perform preventive maintenance, and respond promptly to repair requests.

Your main responsibilities as a Maintenance Technician:

• Maintain and repair automated systems as needed

• Perform maintenance and repairs on lift trucks

• Conduct electrical and mechanical maintenance on all equipment and installations

• Service and maintain order pickers, reach trucks, and combi trucks

The Maintenance Technician we are looking for possesses the following qualities:

• Engineering background

• Ability to work rotating shifts (6h-14h and 14h-22h)

• Hands-on and dynamic approach

• Precision and results-oriented mindset

• Takes initiative and assumes responsibility

• Team player who can also work independently

• Preferably experienced in welding

• Fluent in English; Dutch is a plus

jobs.occupation: Business development manager DACH region - fixed contract
jobs.description:
Searching for a job in sales?
Want to work in a company who's values are doing the right thing, doing waht is best for the customer and driven in improvements and innovations?
The company is Belgium based, but are you willing to travel extensively within the DACH region?

This internationaly active production company is looking for a business development manager who will be responsible for driving sales growth, developing new business opportunities across the German-speaking market (Dach region: Germany, Austria and Switzerland). You will play a pivotal role in expanding the company’s footprint, strengthening relationships with distributors in various markets.

• You will identify and pursue new business opportunities within the DACH region.
• Relationships with distributors and resellers will you build and maintain.
• For accounts in this region, you will serve as the primary point of contact.
• You will develop tailored solutions and proposals to meet specific customer needs.
• The market trends and competitor activities will you analyze to identify growth opportunities.

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.
• At least 5 years of experience in B2B sales, business development, or account management, preferably in the industrial or manufacturing sectors.
• Fluent in German and English (written and spoken).
• Strong understanding of the DACH market and cultural nuances.
• Proven ability to develop and maintain client relationships.
• Excellent negotiation and presentation skills.
• Analytical mindset with the ability to use data to drive decision-making.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office suite and CRM tools.

• 

Trilingual: Fluent in English, Dutch, and French (essential! ). 

• 

Skilled and Professional: Strong administrative, linguistic, and interpersonal abilities. 

• 

Self-starter: Comfortable working independently and managing multiple tasks. 

• 

Well-presented: Classic, professional attire required (no casual wear). 

• 

Reliable and Organized: Punctual, detail-oriented, and proactive. 

Your Responsibilities: 

You are entrusted with overseeing daily operations and ensuring the smooth running of our services. Your duties will include, but are not limited to: 

• 

Welcoming and assisting clients, visitors, and suppliers (EN/NL/FR). 

• 

Managing communications: Answering phones professionally and routing calls as necessary (EN/NL/FR). 

• 

Office Operations: Handling incoming and outgoing mails/packages, filing, data input, and client file management. 

• 

Client Support: Coordinating meeting room and event requests, arranging lunches, and preparing new client offices. 

• 

Problem-Solving: Addressing customer requests, issues, and complaints promptly and professionally. 

• 

KYC – Handling client files in accordance with our obligations under anti-money laundering regulations. 

• 

Administration and Commercial Support: Control, update, and complete client files/data. Process new requests, conduct visits, and be the key to successful new collaborations through meticulous commercial support. 

• 

Facility Oversight: Performing daily checks of common areas, ensuring a tidy and functional workspace, managing stock, and handling kitchen appliances. 

• 

Administrative Reporting: Providing regular reports to management and overseeing office supplies and operations.

- Language, administrative, and interpersonal skills are essential. 

- Computer proficiency: Solid knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, etc.). 

- Multitasking ability: You manage responsibilities efficiently and gracefully. 

- Team player mentality: Though you work independently, you enjoy regular contact with clients and colleagues. 

- Professional ethics: You respect the company, maintain confidentiality, and demonstrate appropriate behavior toward colleagues, management, clients, and partners. You know where the boundaries lie.
 

- Commitment: Understanding the responsibilities and requirements associated with a small organisation in a competitive sector.
 

- Punctuality
 

- Working remotely is not possible for this position.
 

- Dress code in line with the neutrality policy – classic and professional attire.

Your role

As a Customer Service Agent, you will be the main point of contact for customers, workshops and other parties involved. Your goal is to provide excellent customer service while ensuring that every case is followed up accurately and efficiently.

Your main responsibilities will include:

 
• 
Handling incoming phone calls and customer inquiries.

 
• 
Managing emails and providing clear and professional responses.

 
• 
Gathering information and checking data for accuracy and completeness.

 
• 
Providing first-line technical support and communicating with workshops.

 
• 
Keeping customers and all relevant parties informed about the progress of their case.

 
• 
Following up and monitoring agreements with all parties involved.

 
• 
Managing contract-related issues within the agreed deadlines.

 
• 
Managing several cases and tasks simultaneously while maintaining a high level of service.

Working hours

The position is Monday to Friday, with occasional Saturday work during particularly busy periods.

You will work in rotating shifts between 07:00 and 22:00.

Flexibility regarding working hours is essential for this position.

Your profile

We are looking for someone who is customer-focused, communicative and able to multitask in a fast-paced environment.

Knowledge & experience

 
• 
Very good English – essential for the position.

 
• 
Good knowledge of German.

 
• 
Good knowledge of Dutch.

 
• 
Good knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.).

 
• 
Previous experience in administration, customer service or case management is a strong asset.

 
• 
Technical knowledge of the automotive sector, tyres or mechanics is a plus, but not required.

 
• 
No specific experience is required, as full training will be provided.

Skills & personality

 
• 
Excellent telephone communication skills.

 
• 
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

 
• 
Naturally customer-oriented and service-minded.

 
• 
Able to multitask and manage several cases at the same time.

 
• 
Accurate, organised and committed to delivering high-quality work.

 
• 
Stress-resistant and able to remain calm in challenging situations.

 
• 
Flexible and quick to adapt to new tools, procedures and situations.

 
• 
Reliable, motivated and eager to learn.

jobs.occupation: Commercial Coordinator for the Beer Sector
jobs.description:
The Commercial Coordinator role within the FMCG industry focuses on supporting sales, logistics, customer service operations in the beer sector. This position requires organisational skills to manage customer interactions and ensure smooth process optimizations.

Client Details

Our client is a main beer actor in the Belgian industry.

They have a history of knowledge and expertise and are located in Flemish Brabant.

Description

As a Commercial Coordinator your responsibilities are very varied but with as a main goal to optimize all commercial, logistics and sales support processes in the company.

 

Concretely you will:

 

• You work closely with Sales Support, Customer Service, Finance, Marketing, and Supply Chain to ensure efficient commercial operations
• You support and optimize all ongoing commercial processes and give insights on how to make the collaboration between sales, sales support and logistics more efficient
• You analyze commercial figures, market tendencies, promotions to increase commercial insights
• You analyze demand planning processes, market tendencies in the sector to make sure the forecasts are more accurate
• You support sales, sales support, customer service and logistics teams in using the CRM tool well
• You guarantee a flawless and efficient OTC process
 

 

The Commercial Coordinator should have:

• Fluent Dutch, French and English
• Analytical insights
• Able to understand different businesses and how an entire Order To Cash process works
• Good communication and influencing skills

A key player in European manufacturing, uniting over 180 stakeholders from 20 countries. Committed to innovation, it strives to enhance resource efficiency in large-scale value chain productions across diverse sectors.

Jobomschrijving

Primary responsibilities project management support (50%):
	
• Creating timelines and contributing to effective planning of funded project activities.	
• Monitoring budgets of EU-funded projects and tracking team members’ time dedication consistently, systematically, and coherently.	
• Supporting team members in completing tasks, drafting, and submitting reports.	
• Oversee and implement the communication and dissemination tasks of projects.	
• Support organising conferences, events, meetings, and other activities linked to projects.	
• Providing communication support to Processes4Planet projects.

Communications activities and providing value to members (50%)
	
• Create a yearly Communication Plan and track its implementation,	
• Manage and enhance the Association’s external communication channels (website, social media, newsletters, etc.), 	
• Operate members-only collaboration tools (e.g. SharePoint),	
• Manage internal communication with company members by operating the existing tools or suggesting new ideas.	
• Generate and write content for social media, news releases, newsletters, bulletins, etc.	
• Prepare presentations and small publications and manage relations with providers.	
• Support to facilitate networking activities 	
• Organiseparticipation in external conferences, and support with organization of internal events (conferences, workshops, webinars, etc.).

Qualifications and experience:
	
• Degree in project management, communications, public relations, business administration or related studies.	
• Minimum 3 years of experience in positions dealing with the tasks described for this position, with excellent performance.	
• Experience with EU funds is an asset.

Your key skills:
	
• An energetic person with a hands-on approach, task-oriented with attention to detail	
• Team player with a cooperative spirit	
• Ability to work in a small core team and diverse virtual teams with people across organizational boundaries and several countries/regions.	
• Outstanding organisation and prioritization skills with a capacity to retro plan and fulfil strict deadlines.	
• High-quality results and output oriented.	
• Capacity to work with complexity and to juggle a variety of tasks flexibly and proactively.	
• Creative problem-solving skills, able to anticipate needs and deliver your work autonomously
Technical skills and languages:
	
• Strong skills in Word, PowerPoint, Excel and collaborative online tools (e.g. SharePoint).	
• Experience in project management.	
• Excellent spoken and written English. Other languages are an asset.

European association located in Brussels

Jobomschrijving

• You coordinate and ensure the smooth delivery of the assessments, online or face-to-face 
• You liaise with candidates, suppliers, volunteers, committee members, speakers, examiners and hosts
• You work closely with the subcommittee, attending their meetings, taking minutes and ensuring the implementation of their decisions and policies.
• You work closely with the Registration, IT, Finance, Education and Communication departments.
• You carry out various organisational and administrative tasks such as maintaining examination data, drafting reports, updating procedures and policies, and promoting courses and examinations.

• You hold a bachelor's degree or higher qualification and have at least three years' relevant experience in project, administration, event, examination or programme coordination
• English excellent level
• You have a special interest in education and training.
• You are a methodical and meticulous organiser who maintains high standards and pays close attention to detail.
• You show a diplomatic attitude, making it easy for you to interact and communicate in a mature and professional manner within and outside the organisation.
• You are willing to travel by plane (7-8 times a year).
• You are willing to deliver activities scheduled on weekends (9-10 weekends a year).

As a Project Manager you are in charge of the organisation, coordination of assessments for members of the association in many different countries in Europe. 

Client Details

European association located in Brussels

Description
